## Summary

I found a **complete, machine‑checked certificate** for the ninth‑power confinement of rule 4850 at m = 37, of a different kind from mechanisms 1–7: it works component‑by‑component in the Wedderburn decomposition of the group ring, and it shows that every eigenvalue of 4850 lies in the group generated by the cyclotomic units 1 + ζ^d, the root ζ, and one extra element whose cube is a cyclotomic unit. The certificate also explains *why the answer is 9 and not 27*, predicts the exact 27‑adic class (0, 9 or 18) of every eigenvalue, and three of its identities are exact Laurent identities valid at every m. What I could **not** do is derive the seven 37‑specific identities from a conceptual principle; I say so below.

Everything stated as "proved" below was verified by code in this session (F(2^36) arithmetic built from scratch, plus an independent sympy reduction mod (x^37−1, y^37−1) over GF(2)).

## 1. Reduction to 38 one‑dimensional problems (proved, any prime m with 2 a primitive root)

F2[x,y]/(x^m−1, y^m−1) ≅ F2 × F(2^{m−1})^{(m+1)}: the nonzero characters fall into m+1 lines {n·(1,k)}, {n·(0,1)} and on the line through (1,k) the eigenvalues are Frobenius conjugates of g_k(ζ), where **g_k(x) := f(x, x^k) = F(t(x), t(x^k))** (exact). So f is q‑th‑power confined iff each of the m+1 values g_k(ζ) is a q‑th power. For 4850 at 37 the D4‑symmetry groups the 38 lines into 11 classes: axis {0,∞}, diagonal {1,36}, {2,35,18,19}, {3,34,25,12}, {4,33,28,9}, {5,32,15,22}, {7,30,16,21}, {8,29,14,23}, {10,27,26,11}, {13,24,20,17}, {6,31}. (Checked: no eigenvalue is zero at 37; f(1,1)=0 only at the trivial character.)

Two facts about the base: **(B1)** 1+ζ^d = (1+ζ)^{2^{k_d}} where d ≡ 2^{k_d} (mod 37), so for gcd(N,37)=1, Φ_N(ζ) = (1+ζ)^{E_N}, E_N = Σ_{d|N} μ(N/d)·2^{k_d}; mod 3, 2^{k_d} ≡ (d/37). **(B2)** (computed) in F(2^36)*, whose 3‑Sylow is C_27, 1+ζ has 27‑adic discrete log 24: it is a cube and not a ninth power (this is exactly the project's "rule 90 is cube‑confined at 37" fact). Hence ζ^c(1+ζ)^E has 27‑log 24E mod 27, i.e. **it is a ninth power iff E ≡ 0 (mod 3), and a 27th power iff E ≡ 0 (mod 9)**.

## 2. The certificate (all identities proved by computation; listed in the JSON)

Exact Laurent identities (valid at every m):
- g_0 = f(x,1) = t(x)^3 = x^{−3}(1+x)^6
- g_1 = f(x,x) = x^{−6}(1+x)^4 Φ_5(x)^2
- g_2 = f(x,x^2) = x^{−10}(1+x)^8 Φ_13(x)

At 37: E ≡ 6, 2+2·2^{k_5}, 7+2^{k_13} (mod 9). Since (5/37) = (13/37) = −1, E ≡ 0 mod 3 in all three: ninth powers, with 27‑logs 9, 18, 18 (predicted = measured).

Class {6,31}: 6 = 2^{27}, so by symmetry λ(1,6) is fixed by Frob^9: it lies in F(2^9)*, of order 511 = 7·73, coprime to 3 — automatically a 27th power (measured 27‑log 0).

Hub line (1:4), mod (x^37−1): **g_4^3 ≡ x^2 (1+x)^{11} Φ_3^6 Φ_5 Φ_9**, with E ≡ 0 (mod 9). So g_4(ζ)^3 = ζ^2 γ^{3E'} (γ a cube root of 1+ζ), whence g_4(ζ) is a ninth power.

Twisted pairs with the hub, mod (x^37−1), where g_k(x^n) = g_k(x)^{2^t} for n = 2^t is a ninth power whenever g_k(ζ) is:
- g_3(x)·g_4(x^{17}) ≡ x (1+x)^3 Φ_3^{16}  (E ≡ 6 mod 9)
- g_5(x)·g_4(x) ≡ x (1+x)^9 Φ_3^4 Φ_7^3  (E ≡ 3)
- g_7(x^9)·g_4(x) ≡ x^4 (1+x)^{23} Φ_3 Φ_5  (E ≡ 3)
- g_8(x^9)·g_4(x) ≡ x^3 (1+x)^{21} Φ_11  (E ≡ 3)
- g_10(x^{16})·g_4(x) ≡ x^9 (1+x)^7 Φ_3^2 Φ_5^2  (E ≡ 3)
- g_13(x^{18})·g_4(x) ≡ x^2 (1+x) Φ_5^2 Φ_7^2 Φ_9^2  (E ≡ 3)

Each gives g_k(ζ) = (cyclotomic unit)·(ninth power)^{−1} with E ≡ 0 mod 3, hence a ninth power, and E ≢ 0 mod 9, hence **not** a 27th power. This covers all 11 classes: **Theorem (machine‑checked): every nonzero eigenvalue of 4850 at 37 is a ninth power, the ones on classes {4,…} and {6,31} are 27th powers, the others are not.** The predicted 27‑logs (0 or 9 or 18 per class) agree with direct evaluation on all 38 lines.

Stated as a condition on (f, m): *f is q‑th‑power confined at prime m (2 a primitive root) if, for every line, some product of Frobenius twists of line projections of f, containing that line, is congruent mod (x^m−1) to x^c Π Φ_N^{e_N} with Σ e_N E_N · ind_q(1+ζ) ≡ 0 modulo the q‑part of 2^{m−1}−1.* This contains mechanism 1 (split rules have cyclotomic projections on every line) and mechanism 7 as special cases, and it is what actually holds for 4850.

## 3. What is and is not explained

- Group‑ring form (also in JSON): f^{512} = σ_6 f (Frobenius + symmetry, since 2^9 ≡ −6), so ninth‑power confinement ⇔ (σ_6 f / f)^{57} = 1 ⇔ **σ_6(f)^{57} = f^{57}**, and ⇔ f·σ_10 f·σ_26 f = σ_8 f·σ_6 f·σ_23 f (norm to F(2^6) lies in F(2^3)). These are restatements; the certificate above is not.
- Honest limit: I cannot derive the seven mod‑37 identities from first principles. - Where I think the project is off: (a) Mechanism 7 with q = 3 can never certify ninth powers: once f is a cube, f = U·g^3 with U = 1; one needs U·g^9 with U ninth‑power‑valued, or the cyclotomic form above. (b) The "440‑term cube root" is meaningless: f has 3^38 cube roots in the group ring (one choice of ω per component); smallness of one of them says nothing. (c) Irreducibility of f as a Laurent polynomial is irrelevant — confinement lives in the 38 components, each of which can be cyclotomic. (d) I recommend redoing the 37‑census per line class (vector of 11 values in Z/27): this separates "automatic" classes (F(2^9)) from structural ones and will show which of the 110/21/4 rules share components.

P2: at every odd m, the odd part of the period of 4850 is a multiple of ord(t_1)/gcd(3, ord(t_1)), t_1 = ζ+ζ^{−1} (axis line is t^3).
P3: for prime m with 2 a primitive root, the eigenvalue at (1,1) is ζ^{−6}(1+ζ)^{2+2^{k_5+1}} and at (1,2) is ζ^{−10}(1+ζ)^{7+2^{k_13}} (k_d = log_2 d mod m). Hence if 3 | 2^{(m−1)/2}−1: λ(1,1) is a cube iff (5/m) = −1 or 1+ζ is a cube; λ(1,2) is a cube iff (13/m) = −1 or 1+ζ is a cube. Verified at m = 13 and m = 61 (9‑adic logs 0, 7, 5 for lines 0,1,2 at 61 match the formulas). Untested case: m = 181, where (5/181) = (13/181) = +1, so λ(1,1) and λ(1,2) are cubes iff rule 90 is cube‑confined at 181.
P4 (conjecture): every family rule that is ninth‑ or 27th‑power confined at 37 admits a certificate of the form in §2 (cyclotomic products of ≤ 2 twisted line projections); the 4 rules confined to 27th powers have E ≡ 0 mod 9 on every class.
